purpose: Fail-closed, source-backed semantic recomputation for every quarantined PCQM4Mv2 member and the already pre-registered admitted sample of a completed production-v2 geometry release. This gate is independent of producer and structural-auditor feature functions and does not admit P1 training.

trust_root.external_root: An externally reviewed exact semantic-gate script SHA-256 recorded in a separate deployment/execution receipt

permitted_runtime_dependencies: the exact content-addressed vendored E3FP source used by production
independence_boundary.reason_for_same_e3fp_source: The engineering question is whether the immutable payload is an exact replay of the declared historical E3FP implementation. Scientific adequacy versus alternative 3D representations is a separate paper experiment.

selection.rejects: all rows in the v3 semantic plan without exception
selection.admitted: all admitted_payload_sample rows in the same pre-registered v3 semantic plan
selection.rationale: All rejects determine membership and therefore require census review. The admitted sample is an engineering replay sample stratified over every shard and ordinal band; it is not an effect-size or scientific-validity sample.

source_replay.association: SDF ordinal i equals official CSV row i under the production-v2 source contract
source_replay.selected_record_parser: one-record in-memory Chem.ForwardSDMolSupplier with sanitize=true, removeHs=false, strictParsing=true before reproducing the production worker transport
source_replay.production_worker_transport: bytes(source_mol.ToBinary()) in the parent followed by Chem.Mol(mol_binary) in the feature worker
source_replay.identity_projection_and_e3fp_source: the worker-side Chem.Mol reconstructed from the RDKit binary transport
source_replay.transport_precision_boundary: the frozen RDKit binary transport deterministically stores conformer coordinates at float32 precision; atom, bond, and stereo components remain equal and the geometry payload is already float32
csv_requirements: every selected row resolves exactly once
integer idx equals zero-based row index

primary_keys.strict: SHA-256 of canonical isomeric RDKit SMILES UTF-8 bytes
primary_keys.connectivity: SHA-256 of canonical non-isomeric RDKit SMILES UTF-8 bytes

secondary_corroboration.reason: InChI normalization is a useful orthogonal view but is not semantically identical to the frozen RDKit-SMILES identity contract.

hydrogen_and_atom_provenance_recompute.coordinates: finite float32 C-order model_atom_count by 3 array from the same projected SDF Mol

e3fp_recompute.not_required_for: a member whose first terminal production disposition is a hydrogen-projection or identity reject
e3fp_recompute.matrix_rule: Populate [model atom, level] from each shell's explicit center_atom and radius; never infer a level from all_shells list order.
exact_checks: resolved E3FP parameter object canonical SHA-256 equals payload e3fp_params_sha256
recomputed int32 C-order matrix shape equals payload shape
recomputed matrix bytes SHA-256 equals payload e3fp_sha256
recomputed matrix is byte-identical to the decoded payload array
e3fp_recompute.identity_reject_feature_characterization: not part of this release gate; it may be run only as a separately labelled 2D-plus-3D-only ablation feasibility analysis

checks: membership, reject ledger, and semantic-plan ordinal/reason/stage agree
source_address_sha256 recomputes from the locked source address
source molecule identity SHA-256 equals the reject ledger for every reject
for identity-stage rejects, projected geometry identity SHA-256 equals the ledger and strict/connectivity relations reproduce the exact reason

for hydrogen-projection residual-H rejects, the minimal projection independently retains at least one atomic-number-1 atom and the ledger geometry identity remains null because production stopped before assigning it
membership and decoded LMDB record bind the same ordinal, storage key, source address, and logical content hash
source and projected geometry molecule identities equal payload hashes
SDF and official strict identity hashes are equal and match the payload
connectivity identity hash matches the payload
model-to-source atom mapping is exactly equal
E3FP parameter hash and int32 matrix are byte-identical

full_release_artifact_rehash.aggregate_rule: SHA-256 of canonical JSON bytes for the ordered observation rows

pass_conditions: the exact v3 pre-registered selection is consumed without omission or addition
all 13029 reject rows pass every required reject recomputation check
all 544 admitted sample rows pass every required admitted recomputation check
selected source molecules reproduce the production parent-to-worker RDKit binary transport before identity, projection, and E3FP recomputation

source archive, compressed CSV, uncompressed SDF member, E3FP closure, release manifest, audit report, semantic plan, identity contract, payload contract, gate contract, and gate script are content-addressed
the gate script hash is unchanged before source access, before staging, and through final completion publication
every declared shard artifact and the global motif census match declared bytes and SHA-256 before and after source replay
the attested E3FP closure and actual imported module paths remain exact through every required rehash phase
the per-record result ledger and staged report are exclusively created and self-hashed
an authoritative completion receipt and COMPLETED marker are published only after all final checks pass
paper_experiments_not_engineering_gates: repeat the identity replay under at least one separately pinned RDKit version and report classification drift
compare E3FP with distance, angle, torsion, and equivariant geometric encoders under controlled downstream ablations
evaluate whether quarantined stereo-divergent records help a separately labelled SDF-self-consistent 2D-plus-3D ablation
report uncertainty intervals and task-family-specific downstream effects rather than treating exact engineering replay as scientific validation
